title: Creative use cases: brainstorming, ideation, storytelling
body:
AI is a strong creative collaborator precisely because it has no ego about bad ideas — it will happily generate 30 options in seconds, which is exactly what brainstorming needs.

  • Brainstorming — "Give me 15 possible names for a coffee subscription brand aimed at remote workers. Mix playful and professional tones."
  • Ideation — "I want to build a side project using my photography hobby. Suggest 5 different directions, from low-effort to ambitious."
  • Storytelling — "Write a 300-word short story about a lighthouse keeper receiving messages from a ship that doesn't exist."
💡 Use AI brainstorms as raw material to react to, not a finished product — the real creative judgment is in picking, combining, and refining the ideas it generates.
